balls.text: short ball, and wide of off. Salam pulls after riding the bounce, and plays on the bounce to deep midwicket. They attempt two with nothing to lose, and Salam is run-out at the striker's end. He was well short of the crease when the throw landed into Samson's gloves
just short of Chahal at short third! Now Kuldeep goes for the reverse scoop, which rathe came off the back of the bat as the ball was a low full toss around fifth stump
wow, four to fine leg, and on one bounce! A stylish shot from Kuldeep, as he got across the stumps early, and slog-scooped this short-of-a-length ball from eighth stump

ahh, appeal for lbw, and given! This was bowled at a near yorker-length on leg, and seemed gone the moment Stubbs missed. But he has still reviewed, because why not? The ball dips on to a be a near yorker on leg, as Stubbs looked to whip this with his front leg out of the way. There was no bat involved, as the ball struck his back pad. And replays show the ball would have, surprisingly, hit middle stump, and not leg!
belted back over the bowler's head! He just stands a bit deep in the crease, and crashes this length ball around seventh stump for a flat and hard six
flashed over wide long-off! He is across his stumps early, and squats to loft this low full toss which is wide of off. Another forceful hit for six from Stubbs
and again! Almost like a right-handed Pant, he falls over in looking to scoop this length delivery around middle. So the Impact Sub comes in, and pumps two boundaries right away
scoops over the keeper! He gets across first ball, and confidently attacks this length ball on the stumps to leave Ponting with a smile

spooned to short third! Naib perishes in an attempt to keep pumping boundaries. Boult bowled an offcutter on a length around off, getting the ball to shape away. Naib went chipping, but the lack of pace meant he only got an outside edge
ahh, well bowled! Goes for a yorker on leg, which is whipped to deep backward square
pulled to deep square leg! Right in the gap, and excellently timed. Change of pace from Boult, and short around fifth stump. Stubbs waited, and thumped it for four more
a low full toss dipping on a yorker length on off. Pushed aerially towards long-on

honked over deep backward square leg! Massive six, as the ball goes very deep into the crowd. Again Stubbs went across and exposed his stumps, as Chahal bowled full and wide-ish of off. But Stubbs slog swept hard and bang!
short and pretty wide of off. Pulled wide of long-on, and they pinch two
Stubbs gets across this time, and expertly manipulates the field. He squats and reaches out at this low full toss really wide of off, and paddle sweeps to beat square leg to his left
reverse sweeps to deep backward point! He spots three fielders inside the circle on the off side, and switches over to dispatch this fullish ball angled into leg
much fuller, and pretty wide of off. Lofted on a few bounces to long-off's right
shorter side of a length, and wide of off. Naib swipes at it after reaching out, and manages to place it just wide of a diving long-on fielder's right
very full and straight, and clipped to deep backward square
another short ball at a change of pace, as Sandeep rather goes for the bouncer just outside off at 111kph. Naib looks to pull, but is beaten
a short ball around sixth stump, but only at 119kph. Naib lets it go pretty late
a yorker on leg, as Stubbs backs away to whip to deep square
on a length just outside off, and pushed to long-on. Stubbs took off as if he would pinch not two but three runs there
short of a length on fifth stump, and pulled to deep midwicket
turns this fuller ball on middle and leg to deep midwicket
looks to slash, but gets a bottom edge towards extra cover, with the ball rushing through off a shortish length on middle and off
another dot, as Chahal bowls short and slower outside off. Punched to cover
ahh, this skids through off a length on leg, as Stubbs is hit on his front leg in looking to flick
whips this short-of-a-length ball behind square
not all that nicely timed, but the placement is good enough! Plus, the boundary down the ground is short, as Chahal bowled a legspinner on a full length on leg, and Naib hammered that back
full just outside off, and pushed to long-on, as Samson says "Well bowled, anna!"
fuller still, and just outside off. He goes back in the crease to push towards Ashwin
full and dipping on off. Driven to long-off again
on a length just outside off, and punched to long-off
full on middle this time, and pushed towards midwicket
full ball on middle and leg, and nudged towards deep midwicket. Stubbs wanted a second, but was sent back
defends this full ball outside off, but it takes the inside edge to roll away down the leg side

whip-swept straight to fine leg! Pant falls and loses his balance, as he goes swiping late at this full and flat ball on middle. I think the fact that he played it quite late meant he couldn't clear the boundary, even as it wasn't a very big one. DC slightly losing their way ahead of the death overs
full and dipping on off. Driven towards point
full and slower around off. Clipped to deep square leg
dips this on a flatter trajectory and full length on off. A defensive push towards cover by Stubbs
full and angling across towards fifth stump. Pushed to long-on
slows it down, and bowls full on leg. Dabbed towards square leg
length ball just outside off, and punched to deep point

ballooned to point! Ashwin has three, as a dangerous Porel departs. Ashwin went slower, and teased the batter by slightly tossing it up and dipping on a length on middle and off. Porel backed away and went lofting, but the ball popped up off the outside half of the bat
on a length just outside off, and whipped to deep midwicket

looks to slog-paddle sweep behind square, but is beaten. Samson appeals for lbw, but it is turned down. That seemed to be going down the leg side. It was bowled on a length, and skidded through to middle and leg
on a length on the stumps, and slashed off the outside edge towards short third
ahh, now Boult goes really full in the channel outside off. Pant goes driving, but is beaten
the take-your-eyes-off hook over short fine leg! Short ball from Boult from middle, and Pant swivels to get inside the line of the ball and deposit it over the boundary
pushes at this length ball around middle to deep point
honked to deep midwicket! This time Porel isn't fooled by the slower ball, as Boult again bowls quite short around off. The ball bounces rather sharply, and Porel goes on top of it to attack at it
a helicopter-whip from Pant, as the ball is on the shorter side around sixth stump, and Pant sends it wheeling on the bounce to deep midwicket's left
bowls short, and at a change of pace, around middle and off. Porel pulls to deep midwicket with his back leg in the air
short of a length on middle and leg, and punched to long-on
drilled to deep extra cover! This was a low, dipping full toss, which was angling across towards sixth stump, as Porel drove hard to beat the fielder inside the ring
shorter of a length middle and leg, and punched towards extra cover
Avesh shifts his line to go quite full, angling it across for the ball to finish wide of off. Dragged to deep third by Porel
slammed over deep midwicket! Fifty for Porel, too. Short of a length again from Avesh, and this one was bowled on middle and off. Porel rode the bounce, and thrashed it away
short of a length on middle and leg, and clipped to deep backward square leg
full and just outside off. Driven along to wide long-off
short of a length on middle, and swiped to fine leg on the bounce. Boult there almost overran to his right
on a length on middle, and pulled to deep midwicket
very full, and tossed up on middle and leg. Pushed to Ashwin's left

taken at long-off! Ashwin went wide of the crease, and bowled on the fuller side of a length with a horizontal seam around off. Axar went lofting through the line, and ended up giving a catch taken by Parag in front of his stomach
on a length just outside off, and whipped to deep midwicket
bashed over the bowler's head! It lands deep into the stands too. Full ball, and dipping around middle and off, as Axar got his front leg out of the way, and dumped the ball back
on a length on middle, and it straightens. Nudged to deep square leg
slower, and full on middle. Pushed to long-off
shorter side of a length on off, and punched to extra cover
wide outside leg, as he looked to clip but missed
much fuller, and just outside off. Driven to long-off
short of a length around sixth stump, and pulled to deep midwicket

paddle swept to fine leg, and Boult runs and tumbles to his left to push the ball away last moment. But there will be a check by the third umpire... and it hints that Boult's right leg is touching the rope as he is pulling the ball back. That looks like four on first impression. Yup, it is given four. Porel saw a full ball on middle and leg, and played behind the wciket to place it in the gap
good fielding by Parag at long-off, as he runs and dives to his right to keep it to two. Full length around off from Chahal, and drilled down by Porel
on a length, and wide of off. Hacked to point on the bounce
whips this towards deep square leg
slows it down, and goes on the fuller side of a length on off. Turned towards deep square
Porel jumps out first ball, and lets it fly! The ball was tossed up, and full just outside off, as Porel went attacking across the line. The ball is confirmed to hit the ropes on the full
short of a length on the stumps, and quicker too at 99kph. Pulled to long-on
three dots in a row now. He looks to flick this from outside leg, as the ball on a length, and the ball goes in between his legs
on a length, and skidding through on a stump-to-stump line. Slashed towards point
leading edge on the bounce to point! He looks to clip this length ball angling in, but closes the face of the bat early
paddle swept over short fine leg! He swivels to play at this low, dipping full toss on leg, and the top edge takes it over the fielder
tossed up, and dipping on a full length on middle and leg. Pushed to long-on
change of pace, and on a length on off. Poked towards point for a hurried single, as DC get 78 in the powerplay
ahh, another four off an inside edge for DC! Samson dived to his right, but couldn't get a hand, as Axar swung at this length ball angling in and finishing outside leg, but hardly timed it
on a length, and angling into off. Pushed back to the bowler
skips down, and Sandeep bowls a yorker-length ball on leg. Jammed to long-on
swung to deep midwicket! Almost as if to avenge what happened last ball. Fuller side of a length, and angling into middle and leg, as Porel heaved off the inside half of the bat

ahh, Hope is run-out at the non-striker's end! And he walks back immediately, even before the third umpire confirms. This dismissal always hurts, as he was backing out too far outside the crease, and the ball trickled off Sandeep's hands and went on to hit the stumps. Sandeep bowled on the shorter side of a length, while angling it into Porel, who swat-pulled back, only for the bowler to get a hand to his left
fuller, and flatter on off. Pushed to long-on off the inside half of the bat
he goes wide of the crease, and bowls on a fullish length on middle and leg. Porel looked to clip, but was hit on his front pad
pulled over deep midwicket! Shorter side of a length on off, and the ball straightens away, as Porel goes deep in the crease to crash that for six
on a length on middle and off, and punched to long-on

chipped to extra cover! It is a full toss of all deliveries which has Fraser-McGurk falling! Ashwin bowled a slightly high-ish full toss angling into middle, as Fraser-McGurk pushed through, only for the ball to comfortably land in the fielder's hands
angled in on a length on middle and leg, and clipped towards deep square leg

Fraser-McGurk gets to fifty off 19 balls! This time he gets a full toss, which is dipping to finish at a comfortable, lowish height on leg, as he hoicks it over wide long-on to make the over read 4, 4, 4, 6, 4, 6!

you can have all the conferences and discussions, but the result will hardly change. The third umpire confirms that the ball just dropped short of the deep-point boundary. Shorter side of a length from Avesh outside off, and hammered through the line
rammed over mid-off! Avesh is hammered all around, and Samson offers him some comfort now. Short of a length just outside off, and belted back over the short boundary

sliced to a wide-ish deep third! Avesh had that groan after delivering - that potentially meant more effort, but it hardly mattered! Fullish and in the channel, as Fraser-McGurk opened the face of the bat to loft over point
thumped dangerously to deep extra cover! Avesh goes shorter this time, and around off, as Fraser-McGurk swats back forcefully to beat extra cover

more fortune goes Fraser-McGurk and DC's way! He goes driving at this fullish ball angling in to finish outside leg, and the ball takes the inside edge to roll past and even beat a diving Samson to his right
on a length just outside off, and he swings at it in baseball style again. The ball trickles off the bottom of the bat towards square leg
ohh, this could have travelled had it not been for the bottom edge. He went hooking at short ball angling in towards outside leg, but seemed to have played early
this time the tennis shot comes off! He swats at this short ball angling into him towards off, and goes over extra cover
goes for the tennis-batted swat off this short ball on middle, but is beaten by the bounce
lucky, and four for Fraser-McGurk! He went ramping at this bouncer landing on middle, and backed away to attack that. But the ball went over short third from the outside half of the bat
clubbed into the sightscreen! He stands with his front leg out of the way, and pumps this length ball angling in to finish just outside leg. Great power there
ahh, lovely shot! Places this straight drive in between the non-striker and the stumps, as he presents the full face of the bat at this length on off, and beats a diving mid-off to his left
on a length just outside off, and punched on the bounce to mid-off
chipped over mid-off! It didn't seem all that well timed, as he leaned into the loft off this full ball angling across towards off, and the ball trickled away to the rope
skips down, and ends up hacking this length delivery ending around sixth stump on the bounce to extra cover
ahh, the slower ball right away. Lets it gently float at a full length on the stumps, and Fraser-McGurk, opening his stance up, pushes it down to long-on
looks to slash at this length ball angling across and finishing just outside off, but bunts the ball towards cover for a quick single
goes hoicking across the line at this length ball angling into the stumps, but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat to mid-on

and Fraser-McGurk hits back by launching Boult over mid-off! He preesents the full face of the bat at this length ball angling in, pitching on middle and finishing outside leg, as he makes room to loft

ohh, Fraser-McGurk is down after being hit on the box! The physio rushes out with a little giggle, though. Boult again switched his length, going on a short of a length and getting it to sharply move back in to finish outside leg. Fraser-McGurk was into his attempted pull early, and missed the ball, which went on to smack him. And there is a bit of a delay, as we wait for Fraser-McGurk to be fit enough to resume the action
another dot ball. This time the length is a lot fuller, as the length ball lands on middle and angles in to hit Fraser- McGurk's pad outside leg, as he looked to heave
ahh, short of a length in the channel, and shaping back in to end just outside off. He went swiping across the line, and was beaten
angles this in on a length towards off, and it is clipped to deep backward square leg, in the gap between fine leg and deep midwicket
Nails the yorker, 136ks around off, all Boult can do is jam it back to the bowler.
Into the pitch, seemed slow. Yes, 117ks. Doesn't rise much. Pulled to long-on
Full toss is lowish and around fifth stump, Avesh clears the front leg and lunges, forces it off the flat bat. Gets it straight of mid-off despite splicing it
Back of length over off, pulled to deep square leg's left. They run two

Off stump has been pegged back and DC have effectively won. Mukesh goes for the yorker, not pin-point accurate but gets close enough to the crease to go past Powell's slog. He tried to go over wide long-on and got nothing on it. Mukesh pumps his fists, Pant breathes a sigh of relief
Boult plinks it onto the pitch and back onto his pad, ball fizzles a metre or two in front but the batters are able to get across for a scampered single

Full and wide, Powell's on one knee again and tries to smite it over long-on with a flattish bat. Gets beaten. Wide not given and RR review. It was angling away and Powell hadn't moved across, ball went under the bat as he swung. Bat was well in front of the crease and the ball travelled maybe half a metre further. But the bat blocked the view of the ball from the front-on angle. Third umpire checks from behind but eventually says there is no conclusive evidence to overturn the call.

Nails the wide yorker this time. Powell's front foot is in line with leg stump, back foot just outside off - toes pointing towards point - and he tries square driving it with power. Gets nothing on it. DC review for a caught behind. Doesn't seem like he hit it, it bounces after going past bat anyway. Review gone
Powell, on one knee, slog sweeps it over long-on. Another wide yorker attempted, missed again. Around shin-height, the batter was across which made reaching easier
Nails the wide yorker from around the wicket again. Just inside the tramline and it's jammed to deep third

Missed yorker is a shin high fully this time, it sizzles the turf but has been stopped brilliantly at deep point. Fielder charged to the right and slid seamlessly, got body behind it and kept it to just one
Wide yorker is inside the tramline. Very low fully in fact, beats the attempted square drive

Ashwin, as Ravi Shastri predicted on air, tries to take Kuldeep on. But he holes out to long-on. The roar from Kuldeep is almost as big as it was after the last wicket. Ashwin charged, didn't get to the pitch of the real-slow ball, heaved across the line and got it off the edge. Easy catch
Too full and Pant not too happy. Pushed to long-off
Looks like RR are looking to see off Kuldeep. Length on off, worked to long-on
Gets forward and works it to long-on. Fullish ball around the stumps
Pushes at the fullish wide ball towards point

Pinned on the pad. Ferrerira couldn't have been deeper in the crease and survives the lbw appeal on field. But DC send it upstairs. Pant was unsure but looked like he had no other option but to go up when he did. Kuldeep almost did that thing where he physically got Pant into the T... and he's vindicated! Was a length ball that wasn't far from full, it landed in line with leg (that was the big factor) and straightened to beat the flick. Hit flush on the pad and Hawk-Eye predicts it to crash leg peg. Kuldeep's like a lion personified with raucous roars and fist-pumps
Length on fifth, steered to deep-backward point. Seemed slow, yep, 121ks
Fuller side of length, wide-ish, underedges the cut onto pad

Back to pace-on and it's pulled straight to long-on! 138ks shortish ball around off, Dubey didn't have much room but committed fully towards pulling/flat-batting that over long-on. Stubbs takes it and leaps high in delight. Got it off the top edge. This chase keeps catting and mousing along
Off-pace bouncer this time. Beats the pull
Half-tracker around chest-height. It's pace-on and pulled with power. Races through midwicket
Slot ball, smoked over long-off. Ravi Shastri confuses Shubham Dubey with Shivam Dube but the shot was just as good. Real big six. This was wide and Dubey had a proper swipe at it, went long and far
Misses the line proper this time. Length ball at 130ks is just a bit down leg, doesn't connect with the glance but the deflection takes it far enough from Pant
Helped fine off the back foot, was a shortish ball over middle at the waist. Glanced to the right of long leg for four

Hope's claiming a hoppity ballet catch at the long-on boundary! He moved to the left, took the catch around chest height. The first two-three steps were with both feet stuttering and sliding forward. Hope then got the smallest of strides while staying away from the cushion. The boots were almost parallel to the cushion. Did it move though, especially at the second step as he tip-toed towards the cushion? Commentators unsure, Samson - who was halfway back - was returning but it's given out. He's now chatting with the umpire. He doesn't want to go but is trudging back. Was a slower one on a length outside off, 118ks, Samson pulled it flat. Oh boy, looked like Samson's being suggested to review the umpire's decision but it's too late. Guess that'd have been too much drama to handle
This is why they're going wide, even slot balls go out of reach. 136ks and around the tramline, Dubey looks to drive up and over cover, does so but doesn't find the middle of the bat
Another wide, DC sure are sticking to their plan. This is around a length and angling away, Dubey tries slapping it square. Misses
Low fully at 132ks around off, Samson seemed early on the shot, ends up checking the drive to long-off
Offcutter into the pitch, lands around middle and off and goes just over stump height, past leg stump. Samson made room and tried hoisting it across the line, missed it

Skied... but lands safely! Was a cross seamer on a hard length angling away outside off, Samson went further back in the crease and tried cuffing it with a cross bat but spliced it high. Stubbs ran to the left from long-off but didn't get near enough
Shortish, wide and slow. Slaps it to cover. Another dot

Bumps him and sends down a momentary stare does Khaleel. Samson was crease-bound and moving across, got a pace-on bouncer angling away through sixth. Good height - around the head, to beat the swivelling pull

Misses the mark on the wide yorker this time. 136ks lowish full toss is well outside the tramline, Samson happy to collect four wides in a row. Danny Morrison on air suggests he change the angle, go around the wicket
Wide plan not working. Samson moved across outside off again and Khaleel went fuller side of length. But the slower one slipped out and finished outside the cut strip (landed past the pitch)
Very wide on a length, tries to stay away from Samson's arc but Khaleel's angle is too sharp. Let go

Slower cutter. Tennis-ball bounce takes the short ball an age before going to the other end. Samson is deep in the crease and springs up a bit, decides to leave on height. Wide given, Khaleel thinks it's not but Pant isn't convinced on the review after checking with point/cover fielder
Goes for the yorker again. It's a touch too short but not enough for Dubey to get underneath it, 140ks helps the bowler too. GOes for the slog, gets it off the inside edge to deep square leg
Wide on a shortish length, slapped to deep point.

They won't be getting any if Samson continues to skilfully manipulate the field like that. Wide yorker almost nailed but the skip stays deep in the crease and angles the bat while jamming it, gets it wide to deep-backward point's left

Nailed, Dubey has picked the bones out of the slower one. Looked like an offcutter, around a back of length, angling away outside off. Sat up proper (is that an effect of dew?) and the batter stood upright and pulled it over long-on for a 95-metre six. With that, RR take the timeout
Slow and fullish, slips out well down leg. Goes past the heave and on the bounce to the keeper
Helped fine from an off-stump line. Was a length ball too, so not bad by any means, but Dubey stands somewhat upright and flicks it fine
Wide and full, slapped to deep cover

Skimmer clears cover, Ishant has hands on his knees!. The slower one into the pitch almost worked for him, was a bit wide and Samson slapped it. Went off the bottom and Axar, at the edge of the ring, jumped but got no hand on it. He went with left hand only after taking a couple steps to the right. Samson was lunging forward and watching intently till it cleared him, then sprung up. Opposite to Ishant's reax
Slot ball just outside off. Samson, in the bid to make room, clears the front leg and isn't getting the weight into the cover drive. Toes it to cover
Bit too straight, on a length at 137ks, tucked off the hips to deep fine leg, who was rather fine
Hits a length hard. Channel ball at 132ks, punched off the back foot to long-off. Good comeback from Rasikh after the early boundaries
Wide-ish length ball is slapped to long-off. Samson stayed still again
That does stop Samson from moving even laterally across the crease. Length on fifth, he stayed put and tried slapping it, misses

Flat-bat premium. 16 off the first three, is 28 or more on in this over? Strong base deep in the crease from Samson, the front foot is always leg side and goes further to make more room, flat-bats a la Marcus Stoinis to get it sailing over straight long-off
Lucky four between keeper and short third. Samson made room and tried cutting the 137ks hard-length ball around fifth, got it off the bottom of the bat but it raced along the turf
Slot ball outside off, looked slow but not sure, Samson has a free swing and clears long-on with ease
Full on leg, beats the nudge across the line and hits pad
Full just outside off, 90ks, pushed to long-off. Pant says "match ghuma sakta hai" (You can turn this game around) to Kuldeep before mumbling something inaudible
Full and slow just outside off, looked like he wanted to drive towards cover and the ball went off the inner-half of the bat. Along the ground and Kuldeep can only half-stop it
Length just outside off, punched to long-off

And that's why Samson farmed strike I guess. Stands still and gets a pacer's slot ball at leg stump, was across the line to off stump early. Then cleared the front leg and mowed it Andre Russell style, clears long-on by a mile. Brings up fifty too

Shortish ball halfway down the pitch is clipped to deep midwicket. Kuldeep flicked the bails at the non-striker's end while getting into his follow-through. That's how close he's getting to the stumps. Costs him a no-ball too this time
Tad back of length, spins away too, slapped to mid-off

Slower one trims the top of off! Back of hand length ball lands just outside off and spins back in, Parag's eyes lit up and he wanted to maul it. But he was through the pull early and the ball tickled the stumps. Hard enough to send the bails flying. Rasikh twirls his finger above the head in celebration
Wide, low full toss. Well past the tramline, let go
108ks length ball on fourth, driven to long-off
Clips the length ball at the stumps to deep midwicket
Holy hell, that is as dismissive as pulls get! Cross seam again, on a length at 131ks, swatted off the back foot from a fifth-stump line. Top-of-stump height too, sails flat over cow corner
Beaten by pace. Cross seam on a length, just inside the tramline, Parag waited for the ball to get behind him and then cut it, misses
Fullish length ball around off, worked to long-on
Arm ball darted on a fullish length at leg peg. Defended back to the bowler
Length ball around off, punched towards long-off
Tucks the length ball off the back foot, towards long-on

Parag changes his stance completely and follows through with the reverse sweep. Gets it over short third for four. Axar has hands on mouth, he knows how risky that was given the tad shortness in length
Length around off, sticks in the pitch a bit, Parag is early into the push towards cover. Uppish but lands nearby enough to be out of danger
Pushes towards cover for a quick single
Parag doesn't allow Kuldeep to close out the over well. Bad ball too, too wide and full, allowed the batter to kneel across and slap it wide of long-off for an 83-metre six
Full around leg, worked to long-on
Left-arm Afridied on a length around off. Pace again in the 110ks, driven to deep cover. Good reflexes from Parag too
Parag leaves again but this length ball spins back in a bit to come inside the tramline. He resigns with a smile
Slowish low-trajectory length ball. Lands wide and spins away but just inside the tramline. Let go, not wide
Length on off, delivered from close to the crease, driven to cover

Leading edge... doesn't carry to cover. Run-out chance? No, fielder had to come in which allowed time for Parag to scamper through. Was a length ball around off, Parag tried clipping it square and the ball ballooned. Might've been the thickish outside edge actually
Keeps it slower while pulling the length back. Sticks in the pitch and it's cut to cover
Launched, not middled but clears the straight-long-off boundary. Axar inducing the shot by slowing the pace and pushed the length forward a bit. Bat face turned outwards but ball kept sailing
Darting through the over while not leaving the stumps is Axar. Chopped to short third
Full and flat on middle, worked back to the bowler
Slaps the length ball just outside off to long-off
Length outside off, cut to short third
Slides through off the pitch at pace. 91ks on a length, angling away towards fifth, Parag tried cutting square, got it off the underedge and on the bounce to slip
Surprise military medium from Kuldeep. Shortish and around off, 112ks, chipped aerially over midwicket, while on the back foot
Fulling on fourth, 85ks, Parag stays still and slaps it to deep point.
Punches the full ball on fourth to long-off

Done him in mystery! Looped googly on a slight back of a length, gripped in the deck and went away a bit. Samson was deep in the crease and shaped to punch it straight but was through the shot too early and was late in retracting the bat
Fullish on fourth, 92ks, pushed to cover. Timeout taken right after it's available by DC

Underedged onto the stumps! Brave as Deep Dasgupta calls it on air. Not that dissimilar a ball from the last one that was pumped for six. Shorter but still on the fuller side of length if not full. 93ks, landed around fourth and spun a bit. Buttler tried slugging it across the line and toed it back onto leg stump, walks back disappointed as Axar looks up and pumps the air.
Axar goes full and gets punished. Buttler was ready for the arm ball on off, cleared the front leg a bit and smeared it over mid-on
Length just outside off, patted to the off side
Tighter line, closer to off. Flat and on a length, punched to cover
Not at the start. Buttler uses the spin away from him by slapping it over cover. Was a length ball on fifth
Yorker missed, it's a low fully with pace. Samson bends while his feet remain still, checks the on-drive, gets it straight of mid-on for four more. Amazing reflexes, he's 41 off 16!

This is shortish and rises to waist-height. Samson didn't have to move, held onto that middle-and-off guard, stayed inside the line enough to help it over the infield at backward square leg with the pull. Fifty up for RR
Flat-bat pull over long-on. Very straight for an 85-metre six. Just another length ball that he's pulled
Fullish length ball around fifth is punched to mid-off
Length around off, punched to mid-on

High ball, Stubbs gets under it at cover... and puts it down!. He tried taking it with fingers pointing up, it burst through the fingers, popped onto his shoulder and then to the grass. He was falling backwards which meant the ball got a chance to swerve in the air a bit more. Not great technique, as Daren Ganga says
Sits up for the pull. Another knuckle ball, this wasn't all that bad. On a length and over the stumps, Samson making room and maintaining a stable base helped him whack it over long-on
Fullish and on the pads, bread and butter for Samson. He helps it around the corner, four to backward square

Beaten, subdued appeal for caught behind. Not given. Ishant interested but Pant gesticulates he heard nothing. Change of plan from Ishant as he hits the seam this time, on a length just outside off, Samson went across before backing away. All he could do was open the face fully to try and guide it to third. Beaten
This was a gimme. Samson's turning length balls into short ones with ease, the fact that Ishant gave him ample width meant he could cut it easily through covers even though it was a knuckle ball

Slower yorker missed, ends up as a full bunger. But it's on middle and Buttler had his front leg out, may have been taken aback momentarily by the dip, he tried heaving across the line and plinked it towards long leg
Bat turning in the hand again. Goes off the bottom of the bat to mid-off. Was a fullish ball that Buttler tried launching with a drive
He's carved a length ball like it's a half-tracker!. Deep in the crease again, stays leg side of the fifth-stump ball and creamed it with a semi-horizontal bat

Slower one almost leads to a caught and bowled. Into the pitch, spun away and Buttler, whose front foot was out the way, had to reach out. Too much to do, got it off the bottom and close to the stumps at the other end. Khaleel changed direction of his run and reached out, got no finger on it

Clothed but enough power and placement to get it past mid-on. Buttler didn't move his feet much and tried to whack the fullish ball on off over wide mid-on, bat turned in the hand a bit and went above the bowler and past the diving mid-on fielder
Wide of a length from around the wicket, cut to deep backward point

Larruped over long-on. Pre-meditated but without much risk. Samson moved across towards fourth stump and stood real deep in the crease, cut the angle on the length ball going away from him. Crouched a bit and pulled it essentially
Khaleel looking to swing it in, gets it around the yorker length too. Buttler has to slide his front foot across to make way for the flick wide of mid-on
Very wide again. Keeps going away from the fuller side of length, let go by Buttler this time
Walks towards the line of the fifth-stump length ball and pats it towards point for a quick single. Excellent over from Ishant
Beats the full-faced bat. Scrambled seam on a length, fifth-stump line and Buttler wanted to run it fine, maybe pierce the gap at third but played down the wrong line
A bit of width for a change. Around seventh stump but holds onto that good length, Buttler's across and caresses it off the back foot to point
Good from Buttler, walks towards the line of that length ball. Clips it from around fourth stump, to midwicket. Wanted a single but not on
Test length, around that six-metre mark, angles in towards off. Defended without much weight transfer, towards mid-on
Hard length on fourth, 126ks, chopped to deep point off the back foot
Pitched up on off, pushed to mid-off
Length ball is wide and is slapped to deep point

This time Samson goes for the cut and misses. Seam-up length ball this time, angle is still sharp but it landed around fourth stump and kept going away. Samson was a bit late on the shot too, tried to carve it while standing in front of off stump. Wide not given but Samson wants it and reviews. Ball's along if not within the tramline. Royals burn a review
Pitched up at 131ks, doesn't get much swing. Punched from fourth stump to mid-off
Similar line, fullish at 137ks, let go
Wide and full, the angle keeps taking it away. Let go

Khaleel goes wide and removes Jaiswal. Back of length, 133ks, around sixth stump, Jaiswal took a step back and stayed in line with the stumps. He tried to flat-bat it downtown rather than slap it square, didn't have the reach to middle it and got it off the bottom. Ball went right up and Axar moved back, to his diagonal left, from mid-off to take it
On-drive should've gone straight of mid-on but hits Buttler and deflects to the fielder's left. Was overpitched and Jaiswal nailed the drive
